faq.answer: Yes. ACGME compliance is built into the schedule as it is created, not manually checked after the fact. The internal medicine requirements you tell us apply are built in, including the 80-hour limit (averaged over four weeks), the rest requirements between duty periods, and the other duty hour requirements. The review afterwards is a check, not a repair job.
faq.question: Is Scheduling Wizard compliant with internal medicine ACGME duty hour rules?

faq.answer: We coordinate clinic around X+Y scheduling structures common in internal medicine programs. Our team balances continuity clinic half-day assignments against block rotation and call obligations simultaneously, so clinics are staffed without creating conflicts elsewhere in the schedule.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle internal medicine X+Y scheduling models?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard delivers complete block rotation schedules, call schedules, clinic schedules, and attending schedules for internal medicine programs. All four schedule types are built together, so a change in one resolves dependencies in the others. Schedules are delivered as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you.
faq.question: What types of schedules does Scheduling Wizard produce for IM programs?

faq.answer: Your program's rules and requests stay written down with Scheduling Wizard year over year. When a new chief resident takes over, they inherit the written rule set and last year's schedule rather than starting from a blank spreadsheet. This institutional continuity is one of the core reasons programs choose Scheduling Wizard over self-service software.
faq.question: What happens to our scheduling setup when our chief resident changes?

faq.answer: Yes. Many Scheduling Wizard clients use the platform they already have alongside the service. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule building, delivering finished schedules as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you. You then upload those files to whatever platform you already publish through. There is no conflict between the two.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard integrate with your existing platform for schedule viewing?

faq.answer: The process has three steps. First, you submit your program's rules, rotation requirements, ACGME rules, resident preferences, call fairness targets, and clinic assignments. Second, our team builds your complete, compliant schedule. Third, you receive the finished schedule as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, ready to review, approve and publish. No software to learn, nothing for you to configure.

As a program coordinator for an internal medicine residency, I want to ensure our schedules are ACGME-compliant and account for unplanned absences, but I can't manage all the moving pieces effectively on my own.

I’m a residency program director looking for a reliable way to automate the scheduling for my internal medicine residents while maintaining institutional continuity and fairness in call coverage. I need a service that specializes in GME scheduling rules.

As a chief fellow, I'm overwhelmed with creating a call schedule that meets all duty hour requirements while accommodating my colleagues' requests. I need an easy solution that won’t add more work to my plate.
